nom: Alba Botanica Acnedote Maximum Strength Face & Body Scrub for Acne Treatment

avis.texte: I have been using this scrub for over a year 1x/day. I feel my skin is to fragile, I’m 80, to use more than that. I do use an electric scrub brush. I have used other grit, sand and stone scrubs for 15-20 yrs. I just call them that. My skin is always clean. No irritation. Easy to use and smells ok. People have a hard time guessing my age because my skin has no dark spots, is smooth, looks healthy and I’m not heavily wrinkled. I can pass for 70. I know that’s not young but I’ll take it. I highly recommended this product. Rub it on ur wet face, scrub with the brush, splash water on your face to clean. I don’t use a wash cloth and I gently pat my face dry.

I have been using this Acne Dote facial scrub for like 6 months with consistently smooth, acne-free skin. I like that the scrub is brown with nice-sized granules to scrub the dead skin off of my face. The smell is okay, I'm not a huge fan, but I am a fan of how after I scrub my face and rinse the product off, my face feels slightly tingly and cool. It just feels clean, and I love that. The bottle is huge, and you only need a little for your face at a time, so this bottle has lasted me for forever, and the price is great. I usually have issues with facial scrubs breaking out my skin since my skin is sensitive and acne-prone, but this scrub does the trick. I can't use just liquid cleansers, I have to use a scrub, and I've searched a long time for a scrub that I really like. Plus it has great ingredients, and does not contain alcohol, parabens, or phthalates. And best of all, this brand is cruelty free! I use this product first, then a dilution of water and Desert Essence 100% Australian Tea Tree Oil as a toner, and then for moisturizer, I either use Josie Maran Argan Oil Light, Josie Maran Argan Liquid Gold facial tanner or Ultra Repair® Cream Intense Hydration. The acne dote scrub works well with these other products. I highly recommend!

This is a great value for the price. I use this exclusively on my face and it goes a long way. I have been purchasing this product for several months now. The fragrance is light and nice and it works great on my sensitive skin. The exfoliation is light enough for daily use without irritating or drying out my skin. I feel like it has really made a difference in keeping my skin clear

i love this face scrub. it has a nice scent and it leave my face feeling smooth and refreshed. it's not too abrasive and quite mild. i use it once a week and that good enough for me and my acne prone skin

After a years long search for a working acne scrub, I came across the Alba products. At first I was a little skeptical about the 100% vegetarian ingredients, thinking that it wouldn't work, but boy was I wrong! I tried it out as soon as it arrived, and was surprised when it didn't burn my face like other acne products do. The small particles in the scrub make for a very gentle, soothing cleaning! Unlike other scrubs with large, rough particles that scratch my face. I used only a small amount, which was enough to cover my entire face, and rubbed it in for about a minute, and let it sit for five minutes before rinsing. Something that I really liked was that it didn't hurt like crazy when a little got in my eye, and it was rather easy to clean out. While I was rinsing it just felt like my face was cleaner, and I could tell that my pores were open. After when my face was dry, it didn't look oily at all like other scrubs make it! It also didn't dry my skin out anymore than it already is, but made it softer than I can ever remember! After using it twice a day for only four days I am already noticing a huge difference in my acne! The giant zits on my cheeks and chin are fading faster than ever, and almost all of the little blackheads on my forehead are gone! Even the deep blackheads on my nose that have been there for years are getting a little better! I am absolutely amazed at how well this scrub has worked with my acne compared to other products. Proactiv didn't work half this goo

This is one the most consistent product for my sensitive, peely, dry, seborrheic face. Baby soft skin and no irritation. Light exfoliation texture really helps scrub away the sleepiness and relaxing for bed time. Great value!

avis.titre: The only face scrub that works for me
avis.texte: I have tried so many different face scrubs over the years. I have combination skin and most scrubs are either too rough and dry out my skin too much, or they are too gentle and don't really clean that deeply, only at the surface level, (which doesn't really help with acne or clogged pores). This scrub seems to be the perfect balance, it's not too rough. It's the only thing that clears up my acne and keeps my skin clean, clear consistently. Other scrubs, unfortunately cause me to break out even more. Sure, other scrubs may be less expensive, but I am willing to pay a little more for this scrub, because it works for me and shows long term results with consistent use.
Love this stuff! Works great on my chest and face. I can’t find it in stores anywhere here in Montana. I bought 3 bottles and that will last me probably 2-3 years. I love the way it smells and feels!
If you’re looking for something that REALLY exfoliates your skin, far beyond the lightness of silica beads AND won’t make you break out, this is it. I love this product as an evening exfoliator.
I’m Asian with sensitive skin and hormonal acne. This product is really good for keeping my skin clear without harsh and unnecessary ingredients.
I have used this only ever since it changed my face for the better. One of the best face washes I have come across in my 30 years

avis.titre: Great scrub for all aged skin.
avis.texte: This is a great scrub for myself (50) and my daughter (21). I have been looking for a good scrub (with actual granules), not just a gel or basic wash. Most scrubs don't seem to help remove my dry (aging) skin but this works. I was recently visiting a relative who had this in their shower. As soon as I got home, I ordered it (and some other Alba products - all pictured). I had forgotten how much I like the Alba products because once COVID hit, I quit going to the store and just didn't see it. I am really happy that I have them again. I use this daily and do not have any issue with my skin drying out or with sensitivity due to it being a scrub. My daughter was also happy when she saw it in our house because she said it is the only scrub that actually clears up her acne. Her skin is already clearing up. I put a neutral rating for the scent because I don't notice much of a sent at all. However, I'm not a fan of scented items on my face so it makes to difference to me.

I've used this product for years and it's looked like the more yellow bottle. When I ordered it this time it came in the white bottle. I thought they sent the wrong product, but after looking at the ingredients, it's exactly the same. They just changed packaging. In case anyone else was confused or concerned.

This is the only scrub that my face likes. And when I say like I mean lovesss. My skin loves to be exfoliated as well as salicylic acid. This formula is very refreshing and gentle enough for my face. It makes my skin SO soft & smooth. I do use it everyday which I only recommend if your skin can handle it. I also love the natural & clean ingredients. A staple for life.

avis.titre: Great For Body; Gentle For Face
avis.texte: The Alba Botanica Acne-dote face & body scrub has a very subtle smell thanks to the willow bark extract! If using on your face, a little definitely goes a long way. The scrub is abrasive enough so you know it is exfoliating your skin but gentle enough that it doesn't feel like it's taking a layer off. It's oil free which is great for us who have oily skin which leads to annoying blackheads for me. I intentionally focused on my oily t-zone, especially while currently dealing with hormonal acne. My face felt clean, after toning there wasn't much residue (dirt) left after cleansing with the product & my moisturizer soaked into my skin better than it did prior to using the scrub. Yessss to not drying my skin out after using & having 100% vegetarian ingredients! Can't wait to use on the rest of my body.

This has to be my favorite product from Alba Botanica. Works for both face and body. I've let a few guys use it and they absolutely love it as well. I use it every other day and it helps keep my skin breakouts to a minimum.

This is the best scrub for those little blackheads you get on your shoulders, back, and behind - I've heen using it for over a year. I use it with a longhandled brush, and it's perfect to use as an ingrown hair preventer before shaving - anywhere. Be gentle when using on the face. The best part is paraben free! Parabens cause breast cancer! Check your deodorant, makeup, toothpaste, lotion, shampoo - switch to a healthy lifestyle now! I love Alba for caring about what goes on my body. The scrub is chocolate colored with no smell and turns slightly creamy once rubbed on. Enjoy!

avis.titre: Great Exfoliator for Face and Body
avis.texte: The Face & Body Scrub is simply amazing. I wouldn't recommend using it daily, but after a day of heavy makeup or a routine of twice a week, this scrub is great for removing dirt and grime trapped deep in the skins pores. The skin is left feeling cleaner than it ever has. This product doubles as a body scrub as well. It's perfect for sloughing off that dry dead skin all over the body. It's also great to use to exfoliate the skin before a spray tan! The color is brown which was strange to me but it works great.

avis.titre: Why is this suddenly making me have a serious allergic reaction?
avis.texte: The stuff in a yellow tube never bothered me! I am sitting here writing this angry review because I currently have a red, puffy, itchy, burning face, neck, ears, and chest! Like I got a REALLY bad sunburn (I didn't! It was this scrub!) 🤬 Not sure if alba decided to change their recipe or what, but I USED TO love this stuff. Smelled great, worked great, was great. Not anymore. Doesn't smell as good as the yellow tube (what i got was in an all-white tube but seems to be the same product?) and definitely didn't leave my skin feeling refreshed! Quite the opposite, I'd say... 😒 Not sure if the white tube is a different formula, but I wont be buying this anymore. Bummer. Painful and annoying bummer.

My daughter uses this product a lot. However in this shipment one bottle popped open at the seem. The box it was shipped in was not damaged. Just this one thing popped open, making a disgusting mess on other items. Has this happened to others??
I received my products but one of them was broken and spilled in the box.
Really bummed. For some reason, this product exploded. Did it get too hot?? I will have to return.

avis.titre: Different than what I’ve been buying in stores for years
avis.texte: Product changed?? I was unsure of what happened, but it’s different packaging and different product inside. I’ve been buying this product from the stores for years. This is different. Doesn’t work as well for me. And the lids for both of the bottles broke after the first couple uses (I got the 2 pack). Will NOT be purchasing again. Very sad.

This used to be my favorite facial product, but they changed their formula recently. It was not an improvement. :( The ingredients list posted on here does NOT match what I received. I took a picture of the ingredient list off the new bottle and off an older bottle to compare. The scrub smells way more medicinal, and the consistency is much runnier. I really dislike it, plus the inaccurate advertising on here - I won't be purchasing this again until they confirm the old formula is back in production.

I just thought this product will work because of reviews. But it didn't worked for me. It makes me itchy and break out my skin really bad.
